title: Mildred's dancing, Chinese takeout and Bing's money story
summary: Anecdotes about her funny dances, ordering Chinese food ('that's seagull') and Bing telling about the 20-dollar bills she once dropped from her bloomers.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Red, listen, another thing about Mildred that I used to get a terrific -- I mean she could dance -- she was a wonderful dancer. I loved the way -- didn't she --
You remember how she'd do all her little dances, that go into her things -- she had a wonderful --
Yeah, I mean cause they were funny, the same way, you know.
I know. Well you know when we first came to New York, used to send out to a place called the Far East to get Chinese food.
See Mildred spent a long while in San Francisco. And there was a place up on Columbus Circle, so they used to deliver it in little tin cans, like you can style, they used to have for beer --
-- and we used to order this moo goo gai pan or something -- Mildred knew the names of all the Chinese dishes, anyway --

And we'd say six cans of this and four cans of this and everything, and she'd put it out, -- one time she was looking at it and said, big slices of breast of chicken in this -- and she walked in and looked at it and said, 'that's got to be seagull; that can't be that much chicken.'
And Bing came over and they gave a party for Mildred over at Joe's house when Bing and Dixie came over, and Bing and I were in the kitchen, and -- and he was doing the La Paulina

show, I think at that time, just started. He was in doing that show and they were living at the Essex House, I remember. So they came over, Joe from the shows and Sally and a bunch of them, so we were in the kitchen he's telling me how fond he was of Mildred and everything. He said, 'You know, when I came down to Los Angeles,' he said, 'Mildred was working in a nightclub,' and he said, 'That first night we came in the club and,' he said, 'went home and she pulled up her dress and she had these bloomers on, and she dropped these bloomers,' and he said, 'I never saw so many 20 dollar bills in all my whole life. He said, 'I thought the world would come to an end with all this money.' He said, 'It fell all over the floor.' He said, -- he said, 'I couldn't say anything for 10 minutes, on account my --'
